translation.name: YAUBADA BONANA VEYAO IVAGUNA Bona Iduna

content: Yoni Tobafitaiso gilulumamala.
Tu medema tovai-nadi Yoni Tobafitaiso gilakayemu ada givebutu Yudiya walaꞋaiya gilulumamala.

Gigahe gigayo, “Yami dewa koyona wanavenikohiyena be wanahagavilami, faꞋina Yaubada yana aituha a gilakayemu. Tova kabisona kaliva Yaubada yana itaveꞋavina againe hinamiyami be aseꞋasediya ginavehivehimeya.”
Boi tuwai-moꞋena Yaubada bonana ana toꞋawatalatalaina ana egana Aiseya hida kaliva Yoni faꞋine gigaheye-vagahina gigayo,
Hidedemi bana Aiseya gigahe.

Tu bana Yoni yana miyami kaliva koyokoyoꞋavana amine. Ana aikeva ma kameli utuutuna againe hiyogona, ada gaiyona bulumakau kwafilina againe hiyogona-ma goline gihifona. Ada anaga ma koloma, kadu ana bwai ma maꞋawa gufadi.
Au kaliva moyaꞋaidi bana againe hiꞋela, miYelusalema be Yudiya ana fafali kalivadi, kadu gufa ana egana Yolidani ana fafali kalivadi moyaꞋaidi hiꞋela.
Yadi dewa koyona hiyauna be Yoni Yolidani againe gikivebafitaisoyedi.

Tu miYuda yadi tonagona tafatafalolodiyao adi egana Falisi kadu Sadusi moyaꞋaidi hiꞋelaꞋela be hinabafitaiso. Yoni giꞋitadi-yo gidakeyedi gigayo, “Omi vaita oloto koyona ana egana vaiba natuneyao amine. Hakwadi givenuwaꞋatami-yo vaita Yaubada yana ilaꞋa omi agaimiya wadaꞋoseni? Keke amifaiweya Yaubada wanaꞋoseni.
Omi wagahe vaita yami koyona wadahegeni-yo wadahagavilami. Au dewa yamumuna wanafaisewani-yo yami hagavila au velemoꞋena ma anahalamanena.

Ada keke wananuwanuwa vaita taumiyao agaimiya wanagahe wanagayo, Ide Abelahamo bwaneneneyao faꞋina, kadu ide Yaubada natuneyao. Au gagahemi Yaubada anafaiweya ginakilowemi tu hida kabala agaidiya kaliva ginabubudi be Abelahamo ana yoꞋoya ginasedi.
KaduꞋe adamoya tamuyoko ahe hiyadalina be ai hinaluꞋinubadi, ada ai saꞋeyana saꞋeyana guwadi keke yamumuna ma hinataladi be aiꞋalaꞋalata againe hinahegedi. Ai-dina amine omiꞋiyao.

IyaꞋeku ma gufa againe gakivebafitaisoyemi higa iyaꞋiyaya vaita yami dewa koyona wadavenikohiyena be wadahagavilami. Iya wai ganagona tu kaliva saꞋeyana wai ginamulina-ma gifaiwalahegeku. Bana kikaiwabu-moꞋena tu iya kwamana kabisoku faꞋina, keke akufaiweya Bana againe ganaveꞋagetoga-yo ana ageyafayafa ganawahini. BanaꞋe ma AluꞋaluwa Mahalina againe tufoimi ginakivebafitaisoyemi be ginavemagami tu tufoimi aiꞋalaꞋalata againe ginakivebafitaisoyemi ma higa ginavematahiwadiyemi.

E, aimo ginaꞋela ada yana abasaibutu ana giꞋe lakahina ginaꞋabina be witi ana abavagakolukolu againe ginasibutuna. AꞋa-moꞋena yana kweda againe ginaꞋiveꞋaveꞋahina tu yogona ai giꞋalata-vagata ma againe ginaluveꞋalahina.” Hidedemi Yoni gilumamala.
Yoni Yesu gikivebafitaisoyena.
Tu Yesu Galili ana fafaliya gitauya ada Yolidani againe gilakayemu be Yoni ginakivebafitaisoyena faꞋina.
Yoni ma nuwanuwana ginahawatana gigayo, “Gavadi-yo iya agaikuya uꞋela be unabafitaiso? Iya kwamana kabisoku be vaita O againiya gadaꞋela gadabafitaiso.”
Tu Yesu gigahena gigayo, “Auwe keke unanuwanuwa. Adamoya unakivebafitaisoyeku be au Yaubada kaliva givehimeyeda amine kanahuluva.” Hidedemi gigahe-yo Yoni givenogala be gikivebafitaisoyena.
Ada Yesu gibafitaiso gihavaina, avaleya gilaka ada auheꞋama lobama giꞋayavalina, ada Yaubada AluꞋaluwana ana ita vaita bunebune amine gihobuhobu tu Bana againe gihobuꞋela ma giꞋitana.
Ada Yaubada agona lobameya gikova gigayo, “Bana hidevama NatuꞋaseꞋaseku. Bana nuwaku gikiveyamumu-moꞋena.”
